content.text: That fixed it — finishing the rest of the clear-up orders.

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H3","instruction_en":"Move the black cable off the hallway door floor over the rug near the power strip.","instruction_zh":"將走廊門口地板上經過地毯的黑色電線移開收好。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H4","instruction_en":"Route the black cable from the power strip away from the hallway door floor and threshold.","instruction_zh":"將走廊門口從延長線經過門檻的黑色電線移開收好。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H5","instruction_en":"Clear the black cable with plug end off the hallway to bathroom floor.","instruction_zh":"將走廊往浴室地板上斜放的黑色電線（含插頭）清除收好。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H6","instruction_en":"Move the white sneakers off the hallway to bathroom floor to a shoe cabinet.","instruction_zh":"將走廊往浴室地板上的白色運動鞋收到鞋櫃。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H7","instruction_en":"Move the white lace-up sneakers off the hallway to bathroom floor to storage.","instruction_zh":"將走廊往浴室地板上的白色繫帶運動鞋收至置物處。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H8","instruction_en":"Remove the blue slippers from the hallway to bathroom floor.","instruction_zh":"將走廊往浴室地板上的藍色拖鞋移走收好。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H9","instruction_en":"Remove the dark blue slide slippers from the hallway to bathroom floor.","instruction_zh":"將走廊往浴室地板上的深藍色拖鞋移走收好。"}
